# Coreenact

> Official Microsoft Solutions Partner for Dynamics 365 Business Central: ERP implementation, NAV-to-Cloud migrations, India GST localization, agentic AI on the Microsoft stack, and 24/7 managed support. Delivery hubs in Haryana, India and Mississauga, Canada.

Coreenact is a business consulting and digital transformation partner helping mid-market and enterprise organizations translate strategic ambition into operational results. Work combines business process redesign, enterprise technology advisory and end-to-end implementation to modernize ERP ecosystems, connect business functions and embed AI-driven automation.

The site is a single-page application; every page below has its own stable URL and can be fetched directly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.coreenact.com/): Practice overview, solution pillars, Business Central add-on suite, technology stack and global delivery hubs
- [Services](https://www.coreenact.com/services): Full-lifecycle Business Central services — implementation, NAV cutovers, upgrades, data migration, integration, GST localization and managed support
- [Solutions](https://www.coreenact.com/solutions): Enterprise solution pillars including Dynamics 365 core ERP, data and AI, scale and localization, security and governance, and EdCore education ERP
- [Industries](https://www.coreenact.com/industries): Industry blueprints for manufacturing, FMCG and wholesale distribution, retail, education and cold-chain supply
- [AI & Agents](https://www.coreenact.com/ai-agents): Microsoft Copilot 101 guide, Copilot Studio agent architecture, autonomous ERP agents and Graph grounding
- [Digital Marketing](https://www.coreenact.com/digital-marketing): Demand generation, SEO, paid media and marketing automation services
- [Case Studies](https://www.coreenact.com/case-studies): Enterprise engagement outcomes with measured results
- [Resources](https://www.coreenact.com/resources): Official Microsoft documentation links, release wave roadmaps, India GST guides and MB-800 certification material
- [About](https://www.coreenact.com/about): Five-phase delivery framework, Microsoft partner competencies and leadership
- [Contact](https://www.coreenact.com/contact): Offices in Haryana, India and Mississauga, Canada, plus an ROI estimator for licensing and implementation cost
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.coreenact.com/privacy-policy): What the website collects (enquiry forms, live chat, browser local storage), who processes it and how to exercise privacy rights

## Service practices

Each practice has its own page under /services/ with lifecycle phases, deliverables and business value.

- [ERP Implementation & Consulting](https://www.coreenact.com/services/erp-consulting): Turnkey Dynamics 365 Business Central and F&O deployments on a five-phase methodology
- [NAV to Cloud Migration](https://www.coreenact.com/services/nav-migration): C/AL to AL refactoring and data cleanse for moving Dynamics NAV to Business Central SaaS
- [ERP Audit & Health Check](https://www.coreenact.com/services/erp-audit): Independent diagnostics on code cleanliness, performance, security and license utilization
- [Global ERP Rollouts](https://www.coreenact.com/services/global-rollouts): Multi-country, multi-entity rollouts on a governed core template
- [India Localization & Tax Compliance](https://www.coreenact.com/services/india-localization): GST, TDS, TCS, e-Invoicing, e-Way Bill and Indian accounting standards in Business Central
- [Security, Governance & Compliance](https://www.coreenact.com/services/security-governance): Role-based access, segregation of duties and Microsoft Entra ID integration
- [Continuous Managed Services & Support](https://www.coreenact.com/services/managed-services): SLA-driven Tier 1-3 support, release wave testing and dedicated solution architect

- [Scale & Localize](https://www.coreenact.com/solutions/scale-localize): Global rollouts, India statutory compliance and NAV-to-cloud migration

- [EdCore Education ERP & LMS](https://www.coreenact.com/solutions/edcore-solution): Admissions, fees, timetable engine and student portal on the Microsoft stack

Each sector has its own page under /industries/ with friction points, engineered outcomes and pre-configured Dynamics 365 capabilities.

- [Manufacturing](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/manufacturing): Discrete manufacturing, BOM costing and shop-floor control
- [FMCG](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/fmcg): High-velocity consumer goods, trade schemes and demand planning
- [Retail](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/retail): Omnichannel commerce, loyalty and store operations
- [Education](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/education): Institutions running admissions, fees and academics on one core
- [Professional Services](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/professional-services): Project economics, resourcing and billing
- [Construction](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/construction): Job costing, contracts and site procurement
- [Maritime & Logistics](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/maritime-logistics): Fleet, freight and voyage operations
- [Healthcare](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/healthcare): Clinical supply chain and back-office administration
- [Distribution](https://www.coreenact.com/industries/distribution): Wholesale distribution, warehousing and cold chain
